title: The ledger and feedback-flag memo files of kf_fresh and kbfacts grow without bound in the shared _cache, one per worktree or sandbox path
goal: kf_fresh's ledger memo and kbfacts' flags memo prune files whose source path no longer exists (or are keyed so a sandbox does not add a file), so _cache holds a bounded count of them

run:
import glob
n = len(glob.glob('_cache/ledger-*.json')) + len(glob.glob('_cache/flags-*.json'))
assert n <= 20, ('memo files in _cache', n)

repro_reason: the defect is accumulation over many runs in the shared cache; the count of files there is the evidence, and a fixture would only show one file
notes: Review gap 3 of SP-wpttdu7u: kf_fresh.py:95 ledger-<sha1 of the ledger path>.json, kbfacts.py:1260 flags-<sha1 of the store path>.json; 197 ledger and 58 flags files, about 49 MB, since 2026-10-27.
